items.label: Daniil Medvedev v Sho Shimabukuro

featured.note: money line shorter than -250; featured selection moved to the handicap inside the -250/+10000 window

items.text: Medvedev arrives in Almaty as the top seed and the world number five with 3,660 ranking points on the 19 October list, while Sho Shimabukuro sits 109th with 555. The Japanese world number 109 has earned his place in the last sixteen, but a ranking gap of more than a hundred places on a quick indoor court is where Medvedev's return game usually settles matters in straight sets. Selection: Medvedev, taken on the -4.5 game handicap because his outright price is shorter than -250.

items.text: Lyon's top seed Flavio Cobolli, ranked sixth with 3,640 points, meets Stan Wawrinka under the lights on Court Central not before 19:00 local. Wawrinka is a wildcard ranked 140th on 401 points; the three-time major winner still has the backhand and the crowd, but across a best-of-three indoors the younger legs and the deeper 2026 résumé should carry the match. Selection: Cobolli, and the -5.5 game line is the price that sits inside the window.

items.text: Panathinaikos lead the EuroLeague table at 5-1 with a plus-90 point difference across six rounds, 4-1 at the Telekom Center, and 5-1 over their last ten. Baskonia are bottom at 1-5, minus 60, and 0-2 on the road. The money line is far too short to be playable, so the originated selection is Panathinaikos -18.5 on the spread, where a double-digit home margin is the model's central case rather than an outlier.
